40020396.author: पदार्थः
40020396.content: ततस्तु then, सचिवैः with ministers, सार्धम् together with, षड्भिः six, नित्यम् always, बलोद्धतैः arrogant with strength, महोदरप्रहस्ताभ्याम् by Mahodara and Prahasta, मारीचशुकसारणैः by Maricha, Shuka, and Sarana.

40020396.author: Translation
40020396.content: Then, accompanied by six powerful ministers, including Mahodara, Prahasta, Maricha, Shuka, and Sarana, he proceeded.

40020397.author: पदार्थः
40020397.content: धूम्राक्षेण by Dhūmrākṣa, च and, वीरेण by the brave one, नित्यम् always, समरगृध्नुना eager for battle, वृतः surrounded, संप्रययौ he set out, श्रीमान् the glorious one, क्रोधात् from anger, लोकान् the worlds, दहन्निव as if burning.

40020397.author: Translation
40020397.content: Accompanied by the brave Dhūmrākṣa, who was always eager for battle, the glorious Ravana set out, as if burning the worlds with his rage.

40020398.author: पदार्थः
40020398.content: पुराणि cities, स he, नदीः rivers, शैलान् mountains, वनानि forests, उपवनानि groves, च and, अतिक्रम्य having crossed, मुहूर्तेन in a moment, कैलासम् Kailasa, गिरिम् mountain, आगमत् he reached.

40020398.author: Translation
40020398.content: He swiftly crossed cities, rivers, mountains, forests, and groves, reaching Mount Kailasa in a short time.

40020399.author: पदार्थः
40020399.content: सन्निविष्टम् settled, गिरौ on the mountain, तस्मिन् on that, राक्षसेन्द्रम् the lord of Rakshasas, निशम्य having perceived, तु indeed, युद्धे in battle, अत्यर्थकृतोत्साहम् extremely enthusiastic, दुरात्मानम् the evil-minded one, समन्त्रिणम् with his ministers.

40020399.author: Translation
40020399.content: The lord of Rakshasas, Ravana, was perceived to be settled on that mountain with his ministers, an evil-minded one extremely enthusiastic for battle.

40020400.author: पदार्थः
40020400.content: यक्षा the Yakṣas, न not, शेकुः were able, संस्थातुं to stand, प्रमुखे in the presence, तस्य of that, रक्षसः Rākṣasa (Ravana), राज्ञो of the king (Kubera), भ्राता brother, इति thus, विज्ञाय having known, गता went, यत्र where, धनेश्वरः the lord of wealth (Kubera).

40020400.author: Translation
40020400.content: The Yakṣas were unable to stand before that Rākṣasa (Ravana), and knowing him to be the king's (Kubera's) brother, they went to where Kubera, the lord of wealth, was.

40020401.author: पदार्थः
40020401.content: ते they, गत्वा having gone, सर्वम् all, आचख्युर् reported, भ्रातुस् of the brother, तस्य his, चिकीर्षितम् intention, अनुज्ञाता permitted, ययुर् went, हष्टा joyful, युद्धाय for battle, धनदेन by Kubera, ते they.

40020401.author: Translation
40020401.content: Having gone, they reported all of his brother's intentions, and being permitted by Kubera, they joyfully went forth to battle.

40020402.author: पदार्थः
40020402.content: ततो then, बलानां of the armies, सङ्क्षोभो the commotion, व्यवर्धत increased, महोदधेः like the great ocean, तस्य of that, नैर्ऋतराजस्य king of Rākṣasas (Ravana), शैलं a mountain, सञ्चालयन् shaking, इव as if.

40020402.author: Translation
40020402.content: Then, the commotion of the armies of that king of Rākṣasas (Ravana) grew like the great ocean, as if shaking a mountain.

40020403.author: पदार्थः
40020403.content: ततो then, युद्धं a battle, समभवद् occurred, यक्षराक्षससङ्कुलम् crowded with Yakṣas and Rākṣasas, व्यथिताश् distressed, च and, अभवंस् became, तत्र there, सचिवा the ministers, राक्षसस्य of the Rākṣasa (Ravana), ते those.

40020403.author: Translation
40020403.content: Then a battle ensued, crowded with Yakṣas and Rākṣasas, and there the ministers of the Rākṣasa (Ravana) became distressed.

40020404.author: पदार्थः
40020404.content: सः He, दृष्ट्वा having seen, तादृशं such a, सैन्यं army, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, निशाचरः the night-wanderer, हर्षनादान् roars of joy, बहून् many, कृत्वा having made, सः he, क्रोधात् from anger, अभ्यधावत rushed towards.

40020404.author: Translation
40020404.content: Seeing such a vast army, the demon Dashagriva, after uttering many roars of joy, rushed forward in a fit of rage.

40020405.author: पदार्थः
40020405.content: ये those, तु indeed, ते those, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य of the king of demons, सचिवाः ministers, घोरविक्रमाः of terrible prowess, तेषां of them, सहस्रम् a thousand, एकैकं each one, यक्षाणां of the Yakshas, समयोधयन् fought.

40020405.author: Translation
40020405.content: Each of those ministers of the king of demons, who were of terrible prowess, fought against a thousand Yakshas.

40020406.author: पदार्थः
40020406.content: ततः then, गदाभिः with maces, मुसलैः with clubs, असिभिः with swords, शक्तितोमरैः with spears and javelins, हन्यमानः being struck, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, तत् that, सैन्यं army, समगाहत plunged into.

40020406.author: Translation
40020406.content: Then, even while being struck by maces, clubs, swords, spears, and javelins, Dashagriva plunged into that army.

40020407.author: पदार्थः
40020407.content: सः he, निरुच्छ्वासवत् as if breathless, तत्र there, वध्यमानः being struck down, दशाननः Dashanana, वर्षद्भिः by raining, इव as if, जीमूतैः by clouds, धाराभिः by streams of rain, अवरुध्यत was obstructed.

40020407.author: Translation
40020407.content: There, Dashanana, being struck down as if breathless, was obstructed by the continuous onslaught of weapons, much like clouds pouring down streams of rain.

40020408.author: पदार्थः
40020408.content: न not, चकार did he feel, व्यथां pain, च and, एव indeed, यक्षशस्त्रैः by the weapons of the Yakshas, समाहतः struck, महीधरः a mountain, इव like, अम्भोदैः by clouds, धाराशतसमुक्षितः drenched by hundreds of streams of rain.

40020408.author: Translation
40020408.content: Even though struck by the weapons of the Yakshas, he felt no pain, just like a mountain remains unaffected when drenched by hundreds of streams of rain from clouds.

40020409.author: पदार्थः
40020409.content: सः he, दुरात्मा the evil-minded one, समुद्यम्य having raised, कालदण्डोपमां resembling the staff of Yama (Death), गदाम् mace, प्रविवेश entered, ततः then, सैन्यं the army, नयन् leading, यक्षान् the Yakshas, यमक्षयम् to the abode of Yama (death)

40020409.author: Translation
40020409.content: The evil-minded one, having raised his mace resembling the staff of Yama, then entered the army, leading the Yakshas to their death.

40020410.author: पदार्थः
40020410.content: सः he, कक्षमिव like a dry forest, विस्तीर्णं vast, शुष्केन्धनमिव like dry fuel, आकुलम् crowded/filled, वातेन by the wind, अग्निः fire, इव like, आयत्तः empowered/driven, यक्षसैन्यं the Yaksha army, ददाह burned, तत् that

40020410.author: Translation
40020410.content: He, like a fire empowered by the wind, burned that vast Yaksha army, which was crowded like a dry forest filled with dry fuel.

40020411.author: पदार्थः
40020411.content: तैः by them, तु indeed, तत्र there, महामात्यैः by the great ministers, महोदरशुकादिभिः like Mahodara, Shuka, and others, अल्पावशेषाः few remaining, ते those, यक्षाः Yakshas, कृताः were made, वातैः by winds, इव like, अम्बुदाः clouds

40020411.author: Translation
40020411.content: There, those Yakshas were reduced to a few remaining, like clouds scattered by winds, by those great ministers such as Mahodara and Shuka.

40020412.author: पदार्थः
40020412.content: केचित् some, समाहताः struck down, भग्नाः broken/defeated, पतिताः fallen, समरक्षितौ on the battlefield, ओष्ठांश्च and their lips, दशनैः with teeth, तीक्ष्णैः sharp, अदशन् bit, कुपिताः enraged, रणे in battle

40020412.author: Translation
40020412.content: Some, struck down and defeated, fell on the battlefield, while others, enraged in battle, bit their lips with sharp teeth.

40020413.author: पदार्थः
40020413.content: श्रान्ताः exhausted, च and, अन्योन्यम् each other, आलिङ्ग्य embracing, भ्रष्टशस्त्राः with lost weapons, रणाजिरे on the battlefield, सीदन्ति sank/collapsed, च and, तदा then, यक्षाः the Yakshas, कूलाः riverbanks, इव like, जलेन by water, ह indeed

40020413.author: Translation
40020413.content: Exhausted and with their weapons lost, the Yakshas then collapsed on the battlefield, embracing each other, like riverbanks eroded by water.

40020414.author: पदार्थः
40020414.content: हतानां of those killed, गच्छतां of those going, स्वर्गं to heaven, युध्यतां of those fighting, पृथिवीतले on the surface of the earth, प्रेक्षताम् of those watching, ऋषिसङ्घानां of the groups of sages, न not, बभूव there was, अन्तरं space, दिवि in the sky.

40020414.author: Translation
40020414.content: There was no space left in the sky due to the multitude of those killed going to heaven, those fighting on earth, and the groups of sages watching.

40020415.author: पदार्थः
40020415.content: भग्नांस्तु but those defeated, तान् them, समालक्ष्य having seen, यक्षेन्द्रांस्तु and the great Yaksha chiefs, महाबलान् very powerful, धनाध्यक्षो the lord of wealth, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed, प्रेषयामास sent, यक्षकान् other Yakshas.

40020415.author: Translation
40020415.content: Seeing those powerful Yaksha chiefs defeated, the mighty-armed Kubera, the lord of wealth, dispatched other Yakshas.

40020416.author: पदार्थः
40020416.content: एतस्मिन् in this, अन्तरे interval, राम O Rama, विस्तीर्णबलवाहनः with extensive army and vehicles, प्रेषितो sent, न्यपतत् fell upon, यक्षो a Yaksha, नाम्ना by name, संयोधकण्टकः Samyodhakantaka.

40020416.author: Translation
40020416.content: O Rama, at that very moment, a Yaksha named Samyodhakantaka, sent with a vast army and chariots, attacked.

40020417.author: पदार्थः
40020417.content: तेन by that, चक्रेण discus, मारीचो Maricha, विष्णुनेव as if by Vishnu, रणे in battle, हतः killed, पतितो fallen, भूतले on the ground, शैलात् from a mountain, क्षीणपुण्य one whose merit is exhausted, इव like, ग्रहः a planet.

40020417.author: Translation
40020417.content: Maricha was struck down in battle by that discus, as if by Vishnu, and fell to the earth like a planet whose merits are exhausted falling from a mountain.

40020418.author: पदार्थः
40020418.content: ससञ्ज्ञस्तु but having regained consciousness, मुहूर्तेन in a moment, स he, विश्रम्य having rested, निशाचरः the night-wanderer, तं that, यक्षं Yaksha, योधयामास fought, स he, च and, भग्नः defeated, प्रदुद्रुवे fled.

40020418.author: Translation
40020418.content: However, the night-wanderer Maricha regained consciousness in a moment, rested, and then fought that Yaksha, who was subsequently defeated and fled.

40020419.author: पदार्थः
40020419.content: ततः then, काञ्चनचित्राङ्गं whose body was adorned with gold, वैडूर्यरजसोक्षितम् sprinkled with sapphire dust, मर्यादां the boundary, प्रतिहाराणां of the doorkeepers, तोरणान्तरम् inside the archway, आविशत् he entered.

40020419.author: Translation
40020419.content: Then, he entered the archway, which was the boundary of the doorkeepers, adorned with gold and sprinkled with sapphire dust.

40020420.author: पदार्थः
40020420.content: तं him, तु indeed, राजन् O King, दशग्रीवं Dashagriva, प्रविशन्तं entering, निशाचरम् the night-wanderer, सूर्यभानुरिति by the name Suryabhanu, ख्यातो known, द्वारपालो the doorkeeper, न्यवारयत् obstructed.

40020420.author: Translation
40020420.content: O King, the doorkeeper known as Suryabhanu obstructed that Dashagriva, the night-wanderer, as he was entering.

40020421.author: पदार्थः
40020421.content: स he, वार्यमाणो being obstructed, यक्षेण by the Yaksha, प्रविवेश entered, निशाचरः the night-wanderer, यदा when, तु but, वारितो obstructed, राम O Rama, न व्यतिष्ठत् did not stop, स that, राक्षसः demon.

40020421.author: Translation
40020421.content: Though obstructed by the Yaksha, the night-wanderer entered, and O Rama, when that demon was stopped, he did not halt.

40020422.author: पदार्थः
40020422.content: ततः then, तोरणम् the archway, उत्पाट्य having uprooted, तेन by that, यक्षेण Yaksha, ताडितः struck, रुधिरं blood, प्रस्रवन् flowing, भाति appears, शैलो a mountain, धातुस्रवैरिव like streams of minerals.

40020422.author: Translation
40020422.content: Then, having uprooted the archway, he was struck by that Yaksha, and with blood flowing, he appeared like a mountain with streams of minerals.

40020423.author: पदार्थः
40020423.content: स he, शैलशिखराभेण resembling a mountain peak, तोरणेन by the archway, समाहतः struck, जगाम न did not suffer, क्षतिं harm, वीरो the hero, वरदानात् due to the boon, स्वयम्भुवः of Svayambhu (Brahma).

40020423.author: Translation
40020423.content: Though struck by the archway resembling a mountain peak, the hero suffered no harm due to the boon granted by Svayambhu (Brahma).

40020424.author: पदार्थः
40020424.content: तेनैव by that very, तोरणेन by the archway, अथ then, यक्षः the Yaksha, तेन by him, अभिताडितः struck, न not, अदृश्यत was seen, तदा then, यक्षः the Yaksha, भस्मीकृततनुः having his body turned to ashes, तदा then.

40020424.author: Translation
40020424.content: The Yaksha, struck by Ravana with that very archway, was then not seen, his body having been reduced to ashes.

40020425.author: पदार्थः
40020425.content: ततः then, प्रदुद्रुवुः fled, सर्वे all, दृष्ट्वा having seen, रक्षःपराक्रमम् the prowess of the Rakshasa, ततः then, नदीः into rivers, गुहाः into caves, च and, एव indeed, विविशुः they entered, भयपीडिताः afflicted by fear, त्यक्तप्रहरणाः having abandoned their weapons, श्रान्ताः exhausted, विवर्णवदनाः with pale faces, तदा then.

40020425.author: Translation
40020425.content: Then, all of them fled, having witnessed the Rakshasa's prowess, and, afflicted by fear, exhausted, with pale faces, and having abandoned their weapons, they then entered rivers and caves. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे चतुर्दशः सर्गः ।। 14 ।। Thus ends the fourteenth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
